summary: Malformed lifecycle input can be silently normalized into valid declarations or escape CLI error handling. Tests miss these cases. Full diff and all changed files were inspected; the hash matches. Runtime tests could not be independently rerun.

Traced all five new artifact types through registration, schema versions, Repository.put revalidation, exact digest checking and dependency traversal.
Inspected generation.py:136-165 admission checks and pilot.py:348-391 snapshot/export closure, including alias roots and frozen pins.

blocking_findings.description: Raw collection shapes are lost before validation. For an otherwise valid plan, intent_revision_ids={} or "" becomes an empty tuple; an object keyed by valid intent references becomes a valid pin list while its values are discarded. Selection candidates_considered and kept likewise accept object keys, and rejected={} becomes an empty rejection list. Conversely, null collection values raise TypeError before model validation and escape the CLI's structured error handler. These are malformed declarations, which sealed criterion 3 requires rejecting explicitly. Existing tests exercise valid arrays and semantic errors only.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Validate the raw JSON array fields and rejection-object shapes before iterating or normalizing them. Reject malformed input through the CLI's structured error path without admitting records. Add independent negative cases for object, scalar and null inputs, alongside valid controls and nonadmission assertions.

claims_for_research.claim: Pydantic v2 model_copy(update=...) does not validate supplied update values.
Pydantic 2.13.5 JsonValue discriminates list, dict, string, boolean, integer, float and null, with no tuple variant.
SQLite permits one simultaneous write transaction; BEGIN IMMEDIATE immediately starts one or can fail with SQLITE_BUSY.
SQLite trigger RAISE(ABORT, message) terminates the triggering statement and returns SQLITE_CONSTRAINT with that message.
Python 3.12 hashlib includes sha256 and hexadecimal output through hexdigest.
RFC 8785 sorts object property names by UTF-16 code units and requires UTF-8 encoding.
The referenced third-party Apple Silicon FFmpeg builds have published SHA-256 checksums corresponding to the installer downloads.
FFprobe decoded frame timestamps and time bases support variable-rate addressing independently of rounded average FPS.
The cited FFmpeg stream, rotation and select-filter contracts support the documented coded-orientation, frame-index extraction and RGB24 conversion behavior.
